pool.text: The completion of this cathedral established Warsaw as a ducal seat.
The oldest existing armed seal of the city of Warsaw was created.
Financial and social class disparities led to a minor revolt here.
Sigismund III Vasa transferred his royal court here, establishing the capital.
City records document the use of a crude form of a sea monster.
The opening of the Saxon Garden marked the first publicly accessible park.
A monument dedicated to Frédéric Chopin was constructed in Royal Łazienki Park.
The Warsaw Historical Museum dating back to this year contains exhibition rooms.
The city was bombed and besieged at the start of the war.
The general uprising began as the Red Army neared the city.
The now-defunct FSO was established and became a successful corporation.
The reconstructed Old Town was listed as a World Heritage Site.
The stock exchange was re-established following the end of planned economy.
Moscow became a twin town of Warsaw until a later year.
The metro system opened with a single line and eleven stations.
A new act restored the city as a single urban gmina.
The entry into the European Union triggered a large economic boom.
Warsaw Gallery Weekend began to be held on the last weekend.
The opening fixture of UEFA Euro took place in the city.
Thirteen Varsovian restaurants were appreciated and two received a Michelin star.
